extraction.Name: John Douville
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it
extraction.NOTES: Allottee signed a receipt for the patent. Did ask for patent but was turned down; later the patent was issued without any further request. Sold land for $10,000.00 in cash. Patent delivered in the mail. Has a wife but no children. Has been paralyzed. Was satisfied with the sale of the land. Document number 8.
